subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: Which Feishu card action payload shape should become the maintained contract for `form_value`, `input_value`, `name`, `option`, and `options`?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but prior linked PRs differ between structured JSON payloads and appending fields to command text; that choice affects agents consuming Feishu card actions.

options.title: Structured JSON payload
options.body: Expose button value plus Feishu sibling fields as a JSON text payload for non-button card callbacks, with tests proving simple button clicks remain unchanged.

options.title: Command-string append
options.body: Append form and selector fields to the existing command string for quick-action flows, accepting ambiguity in key/value text parsing for compatibility with command handlers.

options.title: Keep issue open for design
options.body: Leave the issue blocked until a Feishu channel owner defines a public callback contract and updates the linked PR accordingly.

recommendation.title: Structured JSON payload
recommendation.body: Expose button value plus Feishu sibling fields as a JSON text payload for non-button card callbacks, with tests proving simple button clicks remain unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The current implementation lines and recent Feishu card-action refactor blame to this person in local history.
